svg.title: Blocking versus async: the same three requests
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Blocking versus async: the same three requests” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Two timelines. The blocking one runs three requests end to end, each mostly a red waiting-on-I/O bar, finishing at 900 milliseconds with the CPU busy 0.7 percent of the time. The async one starts all three within 52 milliseconds and finishes at 310 milliseconds using exactly the same six milliseconds of CPU.
